desc_en: Full Synthetic, engine oil designed with intelligent molecules that cling to engine parts, reducing warm-up and stop-start wear by up to 50%. It is suitable for modern petrol, diesel, and hybrid engines requiring API SP or ACEA A3/B4 specifications, offering superior protection during crucial startup.
desc_bm: Vehicle Types: Passenger cars, SUVs, and light-duty diesel/petrol vehicles.

desc_en: Perodua's 5W-30 engine oil is a semi-synthetic lubricant designed for a balance of fuel economy and engine protection. It is commonly used for Perodua models like the Myvi, Alza, Axia, Bezza, and Viva.

desc_en: The tall (long) type oil filter historically used for older Perodua models is commonly replaced by part number 15601-00R01-000 (or similar 15601-P2A series).This taller style is generally compatible with older Perodua engines, including the Kancil, Viva, Kelisa, Kenari, Kembara, Rusa, and older Myvi (05-18) and Alza (05-18) models.

desc_en: The new, shorter Perodua genuine oil filter (often part number 15601-P2A14 or 15601-P2A12) is specifically designed for modern Perodua models including Axia, Bezza, new Myvi (2018+), Aruz, Ativa, and new Alza. It is shorter than older, longer variants (like the 15601-00R01) to fit tighter engine spaces in newer models

desc_en: The (big) old-type oil filter for Proton (Saga, Iswara, Wira, Satria 1.3/1.5) is commonly identified by part numbers such as PW510253, O-7314 (OSK), or PW811577-OLD. These, often referred to as high-capacity or early generation filters, fit 1985–2008 models and are widely available from brands like OSK, Bosch, and Proton Genuine Parts

desc_en: The (small) oil filter for Proton vehicles typically refers to the PC121102 part number, often called the -white- filter. It is widely used across most modern and classic Proton models except for the very old Saga (1987) or the Renault-sourced Savvy.

desc_en: For Toyota vehicles, you should choose between a spin-on (metal canister) or cartridge (paper element) oil filter depending on your specific engine model. Genuine Toyota filters are typically manufactured by Denso and are favored for their pre-lubed gaskets and high-quality internal bypass valves
